title: About iziTools
subtitle: Empowering developers and creators with free, easy-to-use web tools

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.content: At iziTools, we believe that powerful web tools should be accessible to everyone. Our mission is to provide a comprehensive collection of free, easy-to-use utilities that help developers, designers, and creators streamline their workflow and boost productivity.
mission.commitment: We're committed to building tools that are fast, reliable, and privacy-focused. Most of our tools process data entirely in your browser, ensuring your information never leaves your device.

offerings.title: Developer Tools
offerings.description: Code formatters, validators, encoders, and more to help you code faster and better.

offerings.title: Design Tools
offerings.description: Color palettes, contrast checkers, and visual utilities for designers.

offerings.title: Productivity Tools
offerings.description: General utilities to make your daily tasks easier and more efficient.

values.title: Privacy First
values.content: Your data is yours. Most of our tools run entirely in your browser, meaning we never see, store, or transmit your information.

values.title: Free Forever
values.content: All our tools are completely free to use. No signups, no hidden costs, no limitations.

values.title: Fast & Reliable
values.content: We optimize for speed and reliability. Our tools are built with modern web technologies to ensure the best performance.

values.title: Accessible Everywhere
values.content: Our tools work seamlessly across all devices - desktop, tablet, and mobile. Use iziTools anywhere, anytime.
